statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // ""'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); out="$model"; [ -n "$dir" ] && out="$out | $(basename "$dir")"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out ($branch)"; [ -n "$remaining" ] && printf "%s | ctx: %.0f%%" "$out" "$remaining" || echo "$out"
